def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    rem = bins - item
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    valid = rem >= 0
    if not np.any(valid):
        return scores
    
    max_cap = np.max(bins) if len(bins) > 0 else item
    is_empty = valid & (bins == max_cap)
    non_empty = valid & ~is_empty
    
    if np.any(non_empty):
        rem_ne = rem[non_empty]
        mean_rem = np.mean(rem_ne)
        scores[non_empty] = np.exp(-rem_ne) - np.square(rem_ne - mean_rem)
        
    if np.any(is_empty):
        scores[is_empty] = -np.exp(-item) - np.var(rem[valid])
        
    return scores
